summary:
Since 2026-10-30 (owner decision, Home), "fdev" is a KVM virtual machine on Home, guest hostname `fdev`; the earlier rootless Podman container `fsharp-dev` is stopped and kept only as a fallback. Facts below were observed by Home on 2026-10-30; recheck live state before relying on them.

Shape: Arch Linux guest with systemd and real root (developer has sudo). QEMU runs on Home in a rootless VMM container (`fdev-vm`) that gets `/dev/kvm` plus the host AMD GPU render node only (no other devices), no capabilities and a read-only rootfs. The render node carries virtio-gpu with DRM native context; Home confirmed the device set in https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4517#issuecomment-6526676894, and see environment/fdev-gpu-and-audio for the device set and the accepted host-driver exposure risk. 12 vCPU / 32 GiB. Disks: root (regenerated from the guest image on every upgrade, so system changes must go into the image source in Home's SystemAdmin repository), home 500 GB on NVMe (`/home/developer`, persistent), bulk 4 TB on HDD (`/srv/bulk`, persistent), a read-only config disk with SSH identity and host aliases, plus Home disk images attached as extra virtio disks (see environment/home-subsystems-migrated-into-fdev).

Boundary: SSH only on Home loopback 127.0.0.1:2222 (keys only; guest sshd has DisableForwarding and PermitTunnel no). An nftables egress filter in the VMM container's network namespace, loaded from Home before QEMU starts (fail closed), allows DNS, the public internet and 169.254.1.2:8443 (legacy telemetry.main.internal route) only; Home, the LAN, the router, the tailnet (100.64.0.0/10) and all IPv6 are rejected. fdev therefore cannot reach Home services; Home reaches fdev over SSH. Root inside fdev does not cross this boundary.

Inside: nested rootless Podman (overlay, delegated cgroup controllers, per-container limits work), rootful nested Podman, nested KVM. Credentials live on the home disk (`~/.config/fdev/credentials.json`, 0600); rotate inside fdev with `fdev-set-credential`. The tmux session `fdev` (windows shell/claude/codex) starts at boot; Home's `Main-fdev` attaches it. Coordination CLI updates and the telemetry queue drain run as fdev user timers.

Still on Home: VM lifecycle (start/stop/upgrade), the Work access path (through Main over Tailscale), dashboard publication units. No Home process exec's into fdev except over SSH.

This version corrects the earlier device line, which said the VMM container gets only `/dev/kvm`; all other statements are carried over unchanged from the version it supersedes. Supersedes the container model described in environment/fdev-pasta-host-name-resolution (now marked historical). Source: Home's private SystemAdmin repository (`Containers/fdev-vm/`); no operation is authorized by this record.
title: fdev is a KVM virtual machine on Home (since 2026-10-30), not a rootless Podman container
